_about: Settings of the real LLM call used for query structuring (src/fashion_planner_orchestrator/llm_provider.py). Model, key and provider come from the environment or .env (LLM_MODEL, LLM_API_KEY, optional LLM_PROVIDER), never from this file. temperature: 0 = the same query gives the same draft as far as the provider allows; null = provider default. See configs/README.md.
